exposure: changes in body mass index (BMI) percentile
Changes in body mass index (BMI) percentile during pregnancy, categorized by the Atalah curve
BMI category according to the Atalah classification
finding: Pregnant women who moved up in BMI category according to the Atalah curve during pregnancy had a higher chance of cesarean section and delivering a macrosomic baby.
mod_finding: Women who moved up in their BMI category according to the Atalah classification were more likely to have a cesarean section.
